scripts.build: node scripts/gen-pages.mjs && node scripts/gen-legal-html.mjs && vite build
scripts.build:store: VITE_STORE_BUILD=1 node scripts/gen-pages.mjs && node scripts/gen-legal-html.mjs && VITE_STORE_BUILD=1 vite build && node scripts/store-clean.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:store && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
